about: Amendments the analysis must know about (Part 9, Table 9.1; Part 8.2: 'a change made after data are in view labels every affected result exploratory'; registration status table: 'A result affected by a change made after the data were seen is reported as exploratory'). One entry per amendment that answers an open question the analysis depends on, or that changes a registered analysis setting. The analysis relabels every verdict an entry with data_seen true affects as exploratory. The go amendment records analysis_code_hash, records.code_hash() at the go decision (Part 5.8; SHA-256 over the analysis code and the modules it imports, analysis/*.py with configs/__init__.py, configs/registered.py, pilot/__init__.py, pilot/budget.py, pilot/contracts.py, pilot/errors.py, pilot/go_decision.py, pilot/manifest.py, pilot/provenance.py, pilot/rundir.py, results/ledger_schema.py and results/supplement_schema.py (records.IMPORTED_CODE: every in-repository module the analysis loads, directly or transitively, function-level imports included), each as repository-relative path, NUL, bytes, NUL in sorted path order). Owner: Role 4, Analysis and results. Read and checked by analysis/records.py.

fields.table_9_1_row: the text of the Amendment column of Table 9.1 (e.g. 'First amendment')
fields.commit: 40-hex commit that records the amendment in the repository, or null while it is not yet recorded (the commit that records an entry cannot name itself: Role 4 enters the hash after the group's ratification)
fields.keys: PENDING keys of configs/registered.py the amendment answers (list; may be empty)
fields.data_seen: true if the change was made after data were in view (Part 8.2)
fields.affects: verdict ids affected (list); an id ending in '*' matches every verdict whose id starts with the rest; verdicts that depend on any listed key are affected too
fields.analysis_code_hash: optional: records.code_hash() at the go decision (Part 5.8 freeze; SHA-256 over the analysis code and the modules it imports: analysis/*.py and records.IMPORTED_CODE, each as repository-relative path, NUL, bytes, NUL in sorted path order)

amendments.table_9_1_row: Decisions on the open questions (docs/DECISIONS.md, decided 2026-10-02), to be ratified by the group
amendments.change: Answers every PENDING key of configs/registered.py (54) as docs/DECISIONS.md records it; each PENDING text states the question and its answer, the code implements every answer, and configs.registered.ANSWERED_QUESTIONS lists all 54 keys.
amendments.reason: The registered text leaves these questions open; they are decided before any data exist, so every result stays confirmatory (Part 8.2). Reasoning per key in docs/DECISIONS_EVIDENCE.md.
amendments.approved_by: Not yet approved: prepared at the request of the pilot owner (Role 1); the group ratifies it at one meeting and enters it as a row of Table 9.1
